# Flutter Client API Surface Inventory

**Generated by**: `explorer_client_survey_1`  
**Date**: 2026-10-11  
**Target Codebase**: Braintech Flutter Application (`lib/`)  
**Base URL**: `https://clubby-andy-irksomely.ngrok-free.dev` (default fallback in `ApiEndpoints.baseUrl` or loaded via `dotenv.env['BASE_URL']`)

## Executive Summary

- **Total Members in `ApiEndpoints`**: 65 (1 `baseUrl` getter, 44 static constants, 19 static helper methods, 1 WebSocket URL builder method).
- **Total Unique Functional Endpoint Paths**: 53 distinct backend URI templates.
- **Active Endpoints with Repository/Service Callers**: 49 endpoint URI paths.
- **Orphaned Endpoints (Declared in `ApiEndpoints` but ZERO callers in codebase)**:
  - `ApiEndpoints.discoverProjects` (`/api/v1/projects/discover/`): Dead code. The client repository `DiscoverRepository` invokes `ApiEndpoints.projects` (`/api/v1/projects/`) instead.
- **Service/Controller-Only Invocations (No Repository Caller)**:
  - `ApiEndpoints.refreshToken` (`/api/v1/auth/token/refresh/`): Called strictly in `AuthInterceptor._refreshToken` (`lib/core/services/auth_interceptor.dart`).
  - `ApiEndpoints.logout` (`/api/v1/auth/logout/`): Called strictly in `SessionProvider.logout` (`lib/views/auth/session/controllers/session_provider.dart`).
  - `ApiEndpoints.chatWebSocket` (`ws://.../ws/chat/{id}/?token=...`): Called strictly in `ChatWebSocketService.connect` (`lib/core/services/chat_websocket_service.dart`).
- **Repositories Falling Back to Hardcoded Mock Data or Stubs**:
  - `InvestmentHistoryRepositoryImpl` (`lib/views/investor/investment_history/repositories/investment_history_repository.dart`): Falls back to 4 hardcoded `InvestmentRecordModel` mock instances and mock portfolio summary on catch or empty list.
  - `InvestorDashboardRepositoryImpl` (`lib/views/investor/dashboard/repositories/investor_dashboard_repository.dart`): Falls back to mock lists for `getBanners()` (3 mock banners), `getFeaturedOpportunities()` (4 mock items), `getTrendingProjects()` (3 mock items), and `getCategories()` (5 mock categories).
  - `DiscoverRepositoryImpl` (`lib/views/investor/discover/repositories/discover_repository.dart`): Falls back to 5 mock deals (`deal_trending_1`..`5`) and 5 mock categories.
  - `InvestorSavedRepositoryImpl` (`lib/views/investor/saved/repositories/investor_saved_repository.dart`): Falls back to 4 mock saved items (`inv_saved_1`..`4`).
  - `InvestorChatRepositoryImpl` (`lib/views/investor/chat/repositories/investor_chat_repository.dart`): Falls back to 3 mock chat conversations (`chat_1`..`3`).
  - `ChatRepository` (`lib/views/sponsor/chat/repositories/chat_repository.dart`): Methods `fetchChats()` and `fetchChatMessages()` bypass the network entirely, returning hardcoded mock lists.
  - `NdaRepository` (`lib/views/sponsor/nda/repositories/nda_repository.dart`): `fetchSponsorNda()` falls back to `NdaAgreementModel.mockData()` on error; `submitSignature()` is a stub returning hardcoded `true`.
  - `ProjectPublicRepository` (`lib/views/sponsor/public_view/repositories/project_public_repository.dart`): Falls back to `ProjectPublicViewModel.mockData()` if project ID starts with `pub_` or `draft_` or if network call fails.
  - `SponsorProfileRepository` (`lib/views/sponsor/profile/repositories/sponsor_profile_repository.dart`): Falls back to static placeholder user on catch.
  - `OpportunityRepositoryImpl` (`lib/data/repositories/opportunity_repository.dart`): 100% hardcoded mock data (`_mockOpportunities`) with `Future.delayed(800ms)`. Never connects to any API.
  - `HomeRepositoryImpl` (`lib/views/home/repositories/home_repository.dart`): Pure stub returning hardcoded `0` unread notifications.
  - `GroupChatRepositoryImpl` (`lib/views/sponsor/group_chat/repositories/group_chat_repository.dart`): Pure stub returning empty lists and mock local sender message.

  - Heartbeat: `{ "type": "ping" }`

## 3. Flagged Endpoints & Mock Remnants

### A. Orphaned Endpoints in `ApiEndpoints` (Zero Callers)

| Endpoint | Path | Issue |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `ApiEndpoints.discoverProjects` | `/api/v1/projects/discover/` | **No caller in entire codebase.** `DiscoverRepository` calls `ApiEndpoints.projects` (`/api/v1/projects/`) instead. Either `discoverProjects` is an abandoned route or `DiscoverRepository` was hooked to the wrong constant. |

### B. Endpoints Called Outside Repository Layer

| Endpoint | Path | Caller Location | Reason / Justification |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `ApiEndpoints.refreshToken` | `/api/v1/auth/token/refresh/` | `lib/core/services/auth_interceptor.dart:134` | Invoked automatically by Dio interceptor on 401 token expiry. |
| `ApiEndpoints.logout` | `/api/v1/auth/logout/` | `lib/views/auth/session/controllers/session_provider.dart:109` | Invoked directly by `SessionProvider` before flushing local storage. |
| `ApiEndpoints.chatWebSocket` | `/ws/chat/{id}/?token=...` | `lib/core/services/chat_websocket_service.dart:40` | WebSocket handshake managed by dedicated `ChatWebSocketService`. |

### C. Repositories with Hardcoded Mock Data Fallbacks or Pure Stubs

| Repository File | Endpoint Associated | Method | Fallback Behavior |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `lib/views/investor/investment_history/repositories/investment_history_repository.dart` | `/api/v1/investor/investments/` | `getInvestmentHistory` | On error or empty list, returns hardcoded summary (`$560,000`, etc.) and 4 mock records (`inv_hist_1`..`4`). |
